senses.gloss: m. ch. (גום, v. אֲגַם) a depression, stagnant water, lake; also marshland, meadow.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 36b:5">B. Mets. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>הבלא דא׳</he> the vapors of the meadow; a. fr. <he>קטל קני בא׳</he> to cut reeds in the meadow = to be illiterate.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 35:7">Targ. Is. XXXV, 7</cite>; a. e.—<cite ref="C01064"><he>אַגְמֵי</he></cite>.
